The electric drive device includes a motor housing that accommodates an electric motor. A heat-radiation base body is fixed to an end surface of the motor housing located opposite the output portion of the motor’s rotation shaft. The heat-radiation base body extends in the direction of the rotation shaft, away from the output portion.

Two redundant electronic control units are arranged along the heat-radiation base body and are thermally connected to it, enabling heat generated by the electronic components to be efficiently dissipated. Each electronic control unit includes a circuit board mounted at an angle relative to the extension direction of the heat-radiation base body. This inclined arrangement supports a compact device configuration while maintaining effective thermal management and redundant control functionality.
outputs.L4:
An electric drive device includes a motor, a motor housing that accommodates the motor, and an output shaft extending from one axial end of the motor housing. A heat-radiation base is provided at the opposite axial end of the motor housing and extends generally in the axial direction of the motor. Two electronic control units are arranged along the heat-radiation base to provide redundant control of the motor. Each electronic control unit includes a circuit board carrying electronic components used to control the supply of electric power to the motor.

Both circuit boards are thermally coupled to the heat-radiation base so that heat generated by power devices and other electronic components can be efficiently transferred to the base and dissipated through the surrounding structure. Rather than being positioned parallel or perpendicular to the direction in which the heat-radiation base extends, the circuit boards are mounted at an angle relative to that direction. This inclined arrangement makes efficient use of the available space behind the motor housing and allows the two redundant electronic control units to be accommodated without substantially increasing the axial length or radial dimensions of the device. As a result, the electric drive device combines reliable redundant motor control with effective thermal management and a compact overall configuration.
outputs.L5:
# Boards

Boards play an important role in many areas of everyday life. In organizations, a board is a group of people responsible for providing direction, making major decisions, and overseeing performance. Corporate boards, school boards, and nonprofit boards help establish policies, manage risks, and ensure that leaders remain accountable.

The word “boards” can also refer to practical tools. Whiteboards and notice boards are used to share ideas and information, while digital boards help teams organize projects, assign tasks, and monitor progress. These visual systems make collaboration easier by keeping priorities and responsibilities clear.

In sports and recreation, boards include surfboards, skateboards, snowboards, and paddleboards. Each type is designed for a particular environment and requires different skills, materials, and safety equipment.

Although boards have many forms, they share a common purpose: they provide structure. Whether guiding an organization, supporting communication, managing work, or enabling recreation, boards help people move forward with greater clarity and control.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract describing an electric drive device with a motor housing, an axially extending heat-radiation base body, and two redundant electronic control units whose boards are thermally coupled to the base body and mounted at a slant.
counterfactuals.output: An electric drive device includes an electric motor accommodated in a motor housing, an axially extending heat-radiation base body disposed adjacent to or integrally formed with the motor housing, and first and second electronic control units configured to redundantly control operation of the electric motor. Each electronic control unit includes a circuit board carrying electronic components, the circuit boards being arranged at an inclination relative to a reference plane extending perpendicular or parallel to an axial direction of the motor. The circuit boards are thermally coupled to respective heat-receiving portions of the heat-radiation base body such that heat generated by the electronic components is transferred to and dissipated through the base body. The inclined arrangement enables compact accommodation of the redundant electronic control units while providing effective heat dissipation and maintaining independent control functionality.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe the structural arrangement of an electric motor drive in which dual redundant ECUs are installed opposite the output shaft and their circuit boards are inclined relative to the heat sink’s extension direction.
counterfactuals.output: The drive has a motor housing with the output shaft projecting from one axial end. At the opposite, rear axial end, two independent ECUs are mounted as a redundant pair. Each ECU includes its own control/power circuit board and heat-dissipating member. The heat sinks extend in a prescribed direction along the rear of the motor, while the circuit boards are mounted obliquely rather than parallel or perpendicular to that extension direction—typically forming an angled, approximately V-shaped package. This arrangement allows both ECU systems and their cooling structures to fit compactly at the non-output end while maintaining electrical and thermal separation.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a single-paragraph technical summary for a patent claim covering an electric drive device with a motor, heat-dissipation base, and two thermally conductive control boards arranged obliquely along the base.
counterfactuals.output: An electric drive device includes an electric motor, a heat-dissipation base thermally coupled to the motor, and first and second thermally conductive control boards configured to control operation of the motor, wherein the control boards are disposed along the heat-dissipation base in respective oblique orientations and are thermally coupled thereto to transfer heat generated by electronic components to the base for dissipation.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate an English patent abstract for a compact electromechanical actuator featuring a motor housing and redundant electronic control units fixed to an axial heat-radiating member, with both boards angled relative to the motor shaft direction.
counterfactuals.output: A compact electromechanical actuator includes an electric motor having a motor housing and a motor shaft extending in an axial direction, an axial heat-radiating member thermally coupled to the motor housing, and redundant first and second electronic control units configured to independently control operation of the motor. Each electronic control unit includes a circuit board fixed to the heat-radiating member and thermally coupled thereto. The circuit boards are arranged at respective angles relative to the axial direction of the motor shaft, thereby reducing the actuator envelope while facilitating heat transfer from heat-generating components to the heat-radiating member. The angled arrangement also permits efficient accommodation of electrical interconnections and provides physical separation between the redundant electronic control units. The resulting actuator combines compact packaging, improved thermal management, and enhanced operational reliability.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4
